```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Fetch live status from the rsrch server
status_data = d3.json("/system/status")

// Function to trigger refresh
refresh_sys = async () => {
    const res = await fetch("/system/refresh", { method: "POST" });
    if (res.ok) {
        location.reload(); 
    }
}
```

# Architecture Deep Dive

## Row {.tabset height=700px}

### Request Lifecycle

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant CLI as User CLI
    participant Router as Express Router
    participant Service as Dashboard Service
    participant Client as Modular Client
    participant Actions as Stateless Actions
    participant Browser as Browser
    participant Graph as FalkorDB
    
    CLI->>Router: HTTP Request
    Router->>Service: Route Call
    Service->>Client: Invoke Component
    Client->>Actions: Execute Action
    Actions->>Browser: Automate
    Actions-->>Graph: Persist Data
```

### Knowledge Graph

```{mermaid}
graph LR
    RT[Research Tasks] --> A[Artifacts]
    A[Artifacts] --> C[Citations]
    RT[Research Tasks] --> O[Observations]
```

### Remote Sync (Halvarm)

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant Local as Local Dev
    participant Remote as Halvarm Server
    
    Local->>Local: Commit & Sync
    Local->>Remote: Build & Deploy
    Remote->>Remote: Job Status: Running
    Local->>Remote: V2 Health Check
    Remote-->>Local: HTTP 200 OK
```
